narration.text: In 1921, Prof. Albert Einstein was at the meeting of the National Academy of Sciences at the Smithsonian Institution.
Harding, Prof. Einstein and his wife were photographed in 1921, on April 25.
Albert Einstein and Warren Harding were with a group at the White House, Washington, D.C.
Albert Einstein was with his wife Elsa in Washington, D.C., with the State, War, and Navy building in the background.
